newsitem.title: USA: Metromail forms database marketing unit.
newsitem.headline: Metromail forms database marketing unit.

text.p: Metromail Corp has formed a Database Marketing Services business unit and named Tery Larrew as president of the operation.

In a release dated January 8, the company said the unit would provide database marketing software, as well as consulting and processing services. It will enfold the offerings of Metromail List Enhancement Services and Customer Insight Co, a wholly owned subsidiary.
Metromail provides database and direct-marketing products and services.
